cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan,find_deficient_cut
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(77)
for case in range(10):
 np=32;n=33;sw=32
 links=[(i,sw) for i in range(np)]
 env={i:random.choice([1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000]) for i in range(np)}
 p=1
 # choose roots summing modest; filter feasible
 for attempt in range(100):
  roots={i:random.randint(1,20) for i in range(np)}
  if find_deficient_cut(n,links,list(range(np)),roots,p,env) is None:break
 else:
  print('no feasible');continue
 t=time.time();out,payload=compile_plan(n,links,list(range(np)),roots,p,env);dt=time.time()-t
 if out=='denied':print('denied');continue
 print('case',case,'D',sum(roots.values()),'trees',len(payload['trees']),'routes',len(payload['routes']),'recipes',len(payload['recipes']),'time',round(dt,2),flush=True)
 validate_plan(payload,n,links,list(range(np)),roots,p,env)
 print('valid')
PY
